method: Actual PDF rasters inspected, including panel crops and facing contexts. Static review-page script and asset references checked; interactive browser controls not tested.
automatedPdfCoverage: All five pages in both units for baseline, ribbon and splash: 30 actual PDF pages.
findings: The deep orange and cream labels are legible against all five green panels.
Both designs fit without collisions; body copy, type sizes and panel heights are preserved.
The unheaded note rewraps to reserve room for the label within its existing panel height.
The ribbon is recommended for its compact shape and slight tilt, consistent with the established labels.
The irregular splash remains an alternative for a more playful accent.
intentionalReplacementsOrOmissions: None: only the proposed badge and space beside the headings/unheaded paragraph are added.
